Makes a bar that shows how far something got. Set how full it is with [UpdateProgBar](UpdateProgBar).

```blitzbasic
;media interact gadgets/createprogbar.gif 4
;media shots 6 400
Graphics 320, 240, 32, 2
win = CreateWindow("Progress", 10, 10, 300, 120, Desktop(), 3)
bar = CreateProgBar(10, 20, 260, 22, win)
done# = 0
Repeat
	e = WaitEvent(300)
	done# = done# + 0.2
	If done# > 1 Then done# = 1
	UpdateProgBar bar, done#
Until e = $803
```

![CreateProgBar](media/gadgets/createprogbar.gif)
@param x       Horizontal position inside the group.
@param y       Vertical position inside the group.
@param width   Width of the bar.
@param height  Height of the bar.
@param group   Window, panel, tabber or canvas that holds it.
@param style   0, or 65536 to not follow the group when it is resized. Defaults to 0.
@returns A handle for the progress bar.
